items.headline: China’s Largest Startup Deal Ever Lifts Global Venture Funding To $59B In October
items.excerpt: Global venture funding in October totaled $59 billion, a 45% jump from a year earlier, per Crunchbase data, in large part due to a record-setting $15.9 billion funding round for China’s DeepSeek.

items.headline: More Money, Fewer Checks: These 3 Charts Show The Divide Behind VC’s Record Funding Year
items.excerpt: Record venture funding in 2026 has been increasingly concentrated in massive AI rounds, while seed- and early-stage deal counts are on the decline. Using Crunchbase data we provide a look at how third-quarter funding continued the year's dollars-up-but-deals-down trend.

items.headline: The Week’s 10 Biggest Funding Rounds: Physical AI And Predictions Lead The Lineup
items.excerpt: This week featured a robust lineup of large rounds, led by manufacturing startup Re:Build, which closed on $2.1 billion, and predictions marketplace Kalshi, which picked up another $1 billion.

items.headline: Sector Snapshot: Travel Tech Funding Heads Toward Multiyear Low Despite AI Push
items.excerpt: Travel demand appears to be holding up, but at the same time, investor appetite for travel tech startups has cooled. Even a wave of startups promising to improve travel with AI hasn’t managed to reverse the funding slowdown. We share what a review of Crunchbase data shows.

items.headline: Jumbo Series A Rounds Hiding The Real Squeeze On Seed Startups
items.excerpt: AI megarounds are masking a shrinking Series A market, leaving seed founders facing higher revenue expectations and longer timelines despite larger seed checks. To improve their chances, MGV's Marc Schröder says, founders should size their seed funding around Series A milestones.
